---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for Lumen
title: "[Feature] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: ""
---

## Problem

What do you want to achieve, and why? ("I want to…" from a real-world perspective.)

## Proposed solution

A clear description of the feature and how it would work.

## Alternatives

What have you considered or tried instead?

## Fit with Lumen's identity

How does this keep Lumen **offline-first, no-account, and gentle**? If it needs a server,
a cloud, or pressure-based copy, please explain why it's still a good fit.

## Additional context

Screenshots, sketches, or notes.
